subtitle: OutX studied 12,000 users across 47 automation tools. The math doesn't work anymore.
author: HeyReach's LinkedIn company page was quietly removed in March.

strategies.label: ✓ INFRASTRUCTURE
strategies.title: Browser-based execution
strategies.body: Browser tools showed an 8% restriction rate. LinkedIn's detection is built around fingerprint patterns, not raw volume.
strategies.takeaway: Where the action runs is the new compliance line.

strategies.label: ✗ INFRASTRUCTURE
strategies.title: Cloud / shared datacenter IPs
strategies.body: Cloud-based tools showed a 31% restriction rate — flagged 4× more often than browser-based, while sending half the volume.
strategies.takeaway: Datacenter IPs are the loudest signal you can send.

strategies.label: ✓ TIMING
strategies.title: Random timing between actions
strategies.body: 200 daily requests on natural pacing get flagged less often than 50 daily on robotic 30-second intervals.
strategies.takeaway: Predictability flags accounts faster than volume.

strategies.label: ✗ TIMING
strategies.title: Fixed delays + daily caps
strategies.body: Robotic 30-second gaps are the real signal — not the request count itself. Cadence is the fingerprint LinkedIn watches.
strategies.takeaway: Same delay every day = same daily fingerprint.

strategies.label: ✓ FINGERPRINT
strategies.title: Real Chrome + stealth + residential proxy
strategies.body: Run a real Chrome session with stealth fingerprint plugins. Add a residential proxy if the account matters to your business.
strategies.takeaway: Look human at the protocol layer or get blocked.

strategies.label: ✗ FINGERPRINT
strategies.title: Same request pattern every day
strategies.body: Identical daily rhythm produces an identical fingerprint. Vary surface area, timing, and action mix across the week.
strategies.takeaway: Repetition is the tell. Variance is survival.
